bullets.text: VMO2 Eyes £2bn Acquisition - **VMO2** is negotiating to acquire **Netomnia**, marking significant UK fibre market consolidation.
Sustainability Challenges Persist - **ACOME** highlights the struggle for telcos to balance sustainability ambitions with cost pressures.
Starlink Gains Spectrum Boost - **Ofcom** grants **Starlink** additional spectrum to enhance satellite backhaul capacity in the UK.
Equinix Invests in UK Data Centres - **Equinix** plans a £3.9bn data centre in Hertfordshire, enhancing UK digital infrastructure.
O2 Partners with Starlink - **O2** collaborates with **Starlink** to improve enterprise connectivity for remote assets.
AI-Native 6G Networks Emerge - **Samsung** explores AI integration in 6G networks to enhance enterprise operations and efficiency.
OneLayer Secures £28m for Expansion - **OneLayer** raises funds to enhance security in private 5G networks across Europe and Latin America.
Nvidia Backs Nokia for AI and 6G - **Nvidia** invests in **Nokia** to advance AI workloads in radio networks and future 6G systems.
